title: After a plain export and import the original writer is still named
what: A plain export is not signed, so the importing server cannot confirm who wrote a note. By design it stamps the importer as the writer and keeps the file's claim, labelled as a claim. The original name must at least survive as that claim.

expect.desc: the original writer is findable on the imported note
expect.title: {{proj}} writer note

expect.desc: the importer is the stamped writer (not the claimed one)
expect.title: {{proj}} writer note

expect.desc: and the note is flagged as arriving unverified
expect.title: {{proj}} writer note
